summary:
tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 no longer writes any parity count. It has three new helpers:
- `Get-RuleCounts` takes no parameters. It recounts Facts (loose `[Fact`/`[Theory` regex), verbatim pattern lines, and twinned entries above the first `# settled by SL-` marker from the tree's own .cs and yaml. It is worked out on first use, and a missing file, no marker or a zero count stops only the case that asks, by name.
- `Format-AgreeLine` takes offsets only (-DFacts/-DTwinned/-DPatterns/-DSettled).
- `Get-ExpectFacts` also takes an offset only.

Every site is rewired to these: C-001, C-003, C-004, C-005, C-007 and C-008, with C-008's delete case at -DTwinned -1 and C-005's mismatch at Facts+1. The literal-count fitness rule gained the four M1/M2 regexes and a second entry covering tests/bugs/SL-069-*.ps1. The repro's setup guard now reads the unchanged copy's counts plus one. A new sibling test, tests/bugs/SL-069-EveryCaseFollowsCounts.Tests.ps1, has 11 shapes, one per owed case.

Results:
- The repro exits 0.
- C-001..C-005 are green on the real tree (AGREE 11/15/27/49) under both hosts.
- All SettledCountProbe shapes hold, and Misclassified still turns C-001 red.
- Every non-engine sibling shape passes.
- C-007 and C-008 through the harness are blocked by a harness failure that predates this slice.

payload.reason: Everything is built and green except O-011 and O-021. Those need C-007 and C-008 to pass through eng/rules-harness/harness.py, and the harness cannot measure at this HEAD. It exits 2 (CANNOT MEASURE) before judging any row, because the engine reports the SL-049 must_not_import rule 'the provider does not use the code it checks' as UNRAN on a scratch copy that has no code graph. I ran it on a `git archive` of HEAD, without any of this slice's changes, and it fails the same way. SL-065 recorded the same failure in all three of its build attempts. The fix belongs in harness.py or the engine, which are outside this slice. Working around it here would hide it. Per M4, C-007 and C-008 are therefore not reached, not passed.

- `Get-ExpectFacts` also takes an offset only.

files.why: Removed `$Twinned = 15` and every literal count. Added the parameterless Get-RuleCounts (an independent recount, lazy and cached, refusing a missing file, no marker or a zero count), Format-AgreeLine (offsets only) and Get-ExpectFacts (offset only). Get-ExpectedSettled now subtracts the derived twinned count. C-001, C-003, C-004, C-005, C-007 and C-008 are rewired to the helpers, and the case titles no longer carry counts.

Limit-Yaml with keepSettled 0 now keeps the first settled marker. The OracleUnavailable 'no settled entries' fixture had also removed the marker, which under the design's no-marker contract stops C-001 with the RuleCounts message instead of 'derived count 0 < 1'. It now tests only what it says it tests.

The engine-written SL-069 entry gained `xunit \d+ Facts`, `found \d+ Facts where the test class has \d+`, `-(Facts|Twinned|Patterns)\s+\d` and `\b(Facts|Patterns)\s*=\s*\d` (M1, M2). A second settled entry with the same patterns covers tests/bugs/SL-069-*.ps1 (M5), because `files` takes one glob.

The committed repro. Its setup guard now expects the unchanged copy's AGREE counts plus one instead of the literal 12/16/28. Its <# #> docstring is reworded without literal counts, because the widened guard would otherwise hit it. The rest is as written.

Sibling scratch-tree test, one -Shape per owed case: SingleScope, TwoScope, ExpectFactsMismatch, C003Settled, SettledMarkers, NoMarker, UnreadableCs, UnseenFact, HostParity, GuardRule, and EngineCases (opt-in with -EnginePython/-EngineRoot). No count of this repo is written in it; expected lines are the unchanged copy's parity line plus the shape's change.

obligations.how: The repro tests/bugs/SL-069-RuleCasesDeriveCounts.Tests.ps1 feeds in one more single-scope Fact plus its twinned entry and now exits 0. The parity tool AGREEs on its scratch copy at baseline+1 (12/16/28), and C-001 prints 'All checks held.'. The SingleScope shape also runs C-001/C-003/C-004/C-005 on that tree under both hosts: green.

The TwoScope shape adds one Fact whose twin is two yaml entries (Core and App scopes), and the copy's parity AGREEs at 12/17/28. C-001, C-003, C-004 and C-005 each exit 0 with 'All checks held.' and the expected 12/17/28 lines, under powershell.exe and pwsh (156 s).

The ExpectFactsMismatch shape runs C-005 on the unchanged copy and on a copy with one more Fact. The mismatch row reads 'found 11 Facts where the test class has 12' and then 'found 12 Facts where the test class has 13', exit 2 both times, and C-005 holds on both.

The C003Settled shape checks that the added entry is the last one above the first marker. C-003 then holds under both hosts: 'the twin of a one-scope Fact deleted' exits 1, and the appended row expects 12/16/28 with 50 settled (clean 49 + 1).

Not reached. EngineCases ran C-008 with the engine on this tree and on the two-scope copy under both hosts. Every harness run exits 2 (CANNOT MEASURE: fitness verdict unable; the SL-049 import rule 'the provider does not use the code it checks' is UNRAN) before any row is judged. The harness does the same on a git archive of HEAD, and SL-065 recorded the same cause. The rewritten Twinned-1 expectation did match the parity line the harness printed ('AGREE 11 facts <- 14 twinned entries, 27 patterns; 49 settled' on this tree, '12 <- 16, 28; 49' on the two-scope copy), but the case cannot pass until the harness can measure.

The SettledMarkers shape confirms the real yaml has 19 settled markers with SL-069's last. C-001 holds on an unchanged copy (11/15/27/49) and on a copy with one more marker and entry (settled 50, twinned still 15), under both hosts. The clean line is 49, not 48; see deviations.

The NoMarker shape cuts the yaml at its first marker. C-001 exits 1 with 'C-001 stopped: RuleCounts: no '# settled by SL-' marker', and no parity row runs. C-002 on the same yaml still exits 0. This follows the m5 correction (the case stops by name) rather than an exit before any case.

The UnreadableCs shape covers three trees: the .cs deleted, every [Fact] renamed, and every pattern line prefixed. Each stops C-001 by name (RuleCounts: no ...ArchitectureRulesTests.cs / no [Fact] or [Theory] line / no verbatim @"..." pattern line) with exit 1 and no parity row, under both hosts.

`SettledCountProbe.ps1 -Shape Misclassified` still exits 0 after the change. C-001 fails with 'FAIL  the repo' and '4 check(s) failed.' on the stub tool under both shells. That run was part of `-Shape All`, which passed in 113 s.

The UnseenFact shape has two variants. [Fact, Trait(...)]: the real reader CANNOT-READs, C-001 exits 1, and the recount passes -ExpectFacts 12. [Fact(Skip = "unseen")] with the copy's tool made blind to it: the tool AGREEs at 11/15/27. C-001 exits 1 with a FAIL on the '12 facts ... 28 patterns' line and 'the reader found 11 Facts where the test class has 12' from -ExpectFacts 12. The loose regex does not share the tool's blind spot.

The HostParity shape takes the two-scope tree, puts a UTF-8 BOM on both the yaml and the .cs, and runs C-001 under powershell.exe and pwsh. Both exit 0 expecting 12/17/28/49, and the ok rows are identical across hosts.

The GuardRule shape parses both SL-069 entries from the yaml. They hit git show a9e0d1d:tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 at exactly 35,240,243,305,326,370,408,600,625,633, and hit nothing in the working RuleCases.ps1 or either SL-069 test (comments included). They hit 8 pinned samples and none of 8 derived templates. SettledCountProbe -Shape GuardRule (SL-053's rule) still exits 0. The engine's own fitness.content_hits finds 0 violations over all 64 rules.

Get-RuleCounts takes no parameters and reads the script's absolute $Repo. Format-AgreeLine takes only -DFacts/-DTwinned/-DPatterns/-DSettled offsets, and Get-ExpectFacts only -DFacts. Both read the cached counts, with settled from Get-ExpectedSettled. The two backstop regexes are added to must_not_match.

Added `xunit \d+ Facts` and `found \d+ Facts where the test class has \d+`. The committed check is the sibling test's GuardRule shape: pinned pre-fix a9e0d1d, a hit required on every listed line, zero hits required on the working files.

Ran it; it is not reached. EngineCases runs RuleCases C-007 and C-008 with -EnginePython/-EngineRoot on this tree and the two-scope copy under both hosts. The .NET 10 SDK was bootstrapped into the gitignored .dotnet/ per Q-003, and builds succeed. Every harness invocation stops at 'the clean baseline is not clean ... fitness verdict unable' because of the pre-existing UNRAN import rule, and the harness on HEAD's own tree does the same. Without the engine arguments the shape reports FAIL 'not reached', never a pass.

The repro's setup guard now expects the unchanged copy's counts +1, and the sibling test takes every expected line from the unchanged copy's parity line plus the shape's change. A second guard entry covers tests/bugs/SL-069-*.ps1. The repro's docstring lost its literal counts, since the engine does not strip <# #> interiors in .ps1. `Select-String tests/bugs/SL-069-*.ps1 -Pattern '\b(1[1256]|2[78]|4[78])\b'` finds only GuardRule's must-hit samples (built with -f, and they assert nothing about this repo). The repro re-runs green against the modified yaml.

Added the variants: marker removed (NoMarker), .cs deleted plus zero [Fact] plus zero pattern lines (UnreadableCs), and an unseen Fact (UnseenFact, both Skip and Trait spellings). Their expectations follow the m5 correction: C-001 stops by name with exit 1 and C-002 still runs. There is no distinct exit code, because M3 was overridden.

cases.test_name: tests/bugs/SL-069-EveryCaseFollowsCounts.Tests.ps1 -Shape EngineCases (fails today: pre-existing harness CANNOT MEASURE)

deviations: Error contract. The design says a recount failure 'exits non-zero before any case runs'. Built instead as SL-053's lazy contract, per the m5 correction: counts are worked out on first use, and only the case that needs them stops, by name ('C-00N stopped: RuleCounts: ...'), while C-002 still runs. No distinct exit code, since M3 was overridden. An eager recount would also have broken SettledCountProbe -Shape OracleUnavailable.

tests/rules/SettledCountProbe.ps1 is touched, though the design meant to leave SL-053's probe alone. Its Limit-Yaml 0 fixture ('only the twinned entries') also deleted the settled marker. Under the design's no-marker contract, that makes C-001 stop with the RuleCounts marker message instead of the probe's expected 'ExpectedSettled: derived count 0 < 1', which I measured as 2 FAIL checks. It now keeps the marker line, so it still tests an empty settled list. The no-marker shape is tested separately in the sibling test.

Two settled entries sit under '# settled by SL-069', not one. M5 widens the guard to tests/bugs/SL-069-*.ps1, but the engine's `files` takes one glob (fitness.py _glob), so the rule is repeated for the second glob. The clean tree's line is therefore 11/15/27/49, not the 11/15/27/48 in O-012's shape. That changes nothing, because settled is derived everywhere.

The repro is not committed 'unchanged', and not only its assertion changed. The setup guard now reads baseline+1, and the docstring (lines 4-5 and 13-15) lost its literal counts. The engine strips only '#' line comments in .ps1, not the inside of a <# #> block, so the widened guard hit those lines. I confirmed the hits with the engine's content_hits before rewording.

The C-004 BOM rows, the C-005 blank-line fixture and both C-008 rows used to compare a prefix without settled. They now compare the full AGREE line from Format-AgreeLine, which is stricter. The lockstep spike had measured all four numbers at these sites, and the C-008 lines matched the harness's own parity output.
Format-AgreeLine also takes -DSettled. M1 listed only -DFacts/-DTwinned/-DPatterns, but C-003's appended entry needs settled+1 and the design keeps settled derived via Get-ExpectedSettled.

The two-scope variant splits across src/FsAnalyser.Core and src/FsAnalyser.App, modelled on NothingWaitsOnTheVolumeFigure, rather than the design's 'arch scope and tests scope'. The shape is the same (Facts +1, Twinned +2), and a tests/**/*.cs scope would scan ArchitectureRulesTests.cs itself in the engine runs.

The unseen-Fact variant uses a copy of the tool stubbed blind to Facts named Unseen*, with a [Fact(Skip = ...)] Fact. The real reader reads Skip (m5 disposition), so without a blind tool the Skip spelling cannot show the loose regex doing anything. The Trait spelling runs against the real tool, which CANNOT-READs.
not_built: The C-007 and C-008 engine runs are required by M4 and O-021 but not reached. The EngineCases shape exists and was run twice. The harness itself cannot measure at this HEAD (pre-existing UNRAN import rule from SL-049), and fixing it means changing eng/rules-harness/harness.py or the engine, which is outside this slice.
tests/rules/SettledCountProbe.ps1:125 (Get-Line's literal 11/15/27) was left as the design decided. It goes stale on the next twinned slice.
follow_ups: Make eng/rules-harness/harness.py able to measure again. taad3.fitness reports the SL-049 must_not_import rule 'the provider does not use the code it checks' as UNRAN on scratch copies (no code graph), so check_clean refuses the baseline and every harness case (C-006..C-014) fails with exit 2. SL-065 found this first, and it reproduces on HEAD. Afterwards run `tests/bugs/SL-069-EveryCaseFollowsCounts.Tests.ps1 -Shape EngineCases` to close O-011 and O-021.

Guard gap: the argument-array spelling `@('-ExpectFacts', '12')` matches none of the rule's regexes. Today it is caught only through the case label or the C-005 message. A regex such as `-ExpectFacts['"]?\s*,\s*['"]?\d` would cover it.
Derive SettledCountProbe.ps1:125's Facts/Twinned/Patterns, the residual the design left open, before the next twinned slice.

%TEMP% holds 288 fsa-parity-case-* dirs created 09:58-10:02 today. They contain an older tree (30 KB yaml, 8.7 KB test class), most likely from the risk-spike's history replay. This build did not create them and left them alone. Measured: RuleCases, current and HEAD, cleans up its own fixtures.
The sibling test's default run (-Shape All) takes about 11 minutes, mostly full C-005 runs per tree and host. If a gate runs tests/bugs/*.Tests.ps1 by default, it may want a cheaper default.

tests.note: Exit 0 after the fix, twice, the last time after every edit: 'OK: RuleCases.ps1 C-001 holds on a tree with one more twinned rule'. It exited 1 before, as the engine recorded.
Real tree: 'AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns; 49 settled entries not compared'.

tests.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 -Case C-001 (then C-002, C-003, C-004, C-005)
tests.note: Real tree, 5.1 as the outer host: every case 'All checks held.'. C-005 took 57 s.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 -Case C-001 (then C-002, C-003, C-004, C-005)
tests.note: Real tree, pwsh 7 as the outer host: every case 'All checks held.'. C-001 shows -ExpectFacts 11 and 11/15/27/49.
The loose Fact regex gives 11 on the clean tree (O-004).
Baseline before any change: exit 0 in 102 s.

After the RuleCases change, before the Limit-Yaml fix: 2 FAIL. The no-settled-entries fixture had lost its marker, so C-001 stopped on 'RuleCounts: no marker' instead of 'derived count 0 < 1'. Fixed in SettledCountProbe.ps1 by keeping the marker.
After all changes: exit 0 in 113 s. Misclassified, CountPlusOne and NotAgree each still give '4 check(s) failed.'; OracleUnavailable, C003Base, BothShells and GuardRule hold.
First run failed (1 check): my stub piped Read-Facts' wrapped array as one object and dropped every Fact. After enumerating it, exit 0.

Default -Shape All, every shape except EngineCases: exit 0 in 656 s. Each shape was also run alone and passed: GuardRule 1 s, NoMarker 13 s, UnreadableCs 3 s, UnseenFact 13 s, C003Settled 16 s, SettledMarkers 15 s, HostParity 8 s, ExpectFactsMismatch 130 s, SingleScope 158 s, TwoScope 156 s.

Exit 1 in 296 s, run twice. Every harness call: 'CANNOT MEASURE: the clean baseline is not clean ... fitness verdict unable; fitness rules that did not run: [the provider does not use the code it checks]'. Builds with the .dotnet SDK succeeded (7-8 s). The rewritten C-008 AGREE expectations matched the harness's parity lines on both trees.
As designed: without the engine arguments it reports FAIL 'not reached' and exits 1, never a pass.

tests.command: python.exe eng/rules-harness/harness.py --engine-root C:\Users\sshub\projets\taad_v3\backend --root <git archive of HEAD in %TEMP%> --dotnet-from . --scenario clean
tests.note: Exit 2 with the same UNRAN import-rule message on HEAD's own tree (47 settled, none of this slice's changes), so the blocker predates the slice. The scratch copy and kept dir were removed afterwards.

tests.command: python.exe -c <taad3.fitness.load + content_hits over this tree, TAAD3_HOME in %TEMP%>
tests.note: The engine loads 64 rules and finds 0 violations across 107 files read. An earlier run, before the repro was reworded, hit the repro's docstring and setup guard at lines 4, 5, 13-15 and 87.
The M5 sweep matches only GuardRule's must-hit samples (lines 453-456, built with -f), which assert nothing about this repo.
Per Q-003 this bootstrapped SDK 10.0.401 into the gitignored .dotnet/ of this worktree in 32 s, for the harness builds.
